annotations.title: Import a Strong or Hevy export

description: Imports a CSV exported from Strong (workouts or measurements) or Hevy, as text exactly as the file has it; the server parses it. A large file can be sent in pieces split on whole workouts, each with the header line and the same batch id. Strong exports omit their unit. Workouts already imported are skipped. Only Strong and Hevy formats.

batch.description: Returned by the first call; pass it on later pieces of the same file.

format.description: Detected from the header when omitted.

text.description: The CSV text, header line first.

unit.description: Unit for every weight in this call. Defaults to the person's own unit.

name: trainrec_import_file
title: Import a Strong or Hevy export
